crossRefs.note: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the…
Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

translations.web: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your abominations, declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith Jehovah.
